item.title: Federal Reserve chairs historically over-communicate what's next. Kevin Warsh wants to say less
item.description: Fed chairs wield great power and they take great care to signal what they intend to do ahead of time to avoid surprises. Not Kevin Warsh though. He wants to say less, and investors are worried.
item.content:encoded: Fed chairs wield great power and they take great care to signal what they intend to do ahead of time to avoid surprises. Not Kevin Warsh though. He wants to say less, and investors are worried.
item.dc:creator: Rafael Nam

item.title: Cost of living has gone up 3.4% in the last year
item.description: A new report shows the cost of living in August was up 3.4% from a year ago. Investors think stubborn inflation makes it more likely that the Federal Reserve will raise interest rates next week.
item.content:encoded: A new report shows the cost of living in August was up 3.4% from a year ago. Investors think stubborn inflation makes it more likely that the Federal Reserve will raise interest rates next week.
item.dc:creator: Scott Horsley

item.title: What it takes to make a new — branded — tomato
item.description: Why is the grocery store produce aisle filling up with branded fruits and vegetables, like honeycrisp apples and cuties oranges? We watch the effort to make one new — branded — tomato.

item.title: Friday's inflation report could help Fed decide whether to raise interest rates
item.description: Consumer prices rose 3.4% percent last month from a year ago, the same as it was in July and matching expectations. Gas prices were among the biggest risers.

item.description: Realtors around the U.S. are being asked to explain how data centers could affect home values. But a new study shows there is no universal answer.

item.title: Why gains by Iran-backed Houthis in Yemen could push gas prices even higher
item.description: A Houthi advance along Yemen's Red Sea coast could help push gas prices up even more as the Iran-backed group also launches attacks on Saudi Arabia's oil facilities.

item.title: Crude oil tops $100 a barrel, increasing prices at the pump
item.description: An escalation of fighting around the Strait of Hormuz pushes the benchmark price of crude oil back above $100 per barrel. That's leading to higher prices at the gas pump, just ahead of a high-profile inflation report.
